caseNameFull: Chandler, U. S. District Judge v. Occidental Petroleum Corp.

opinions.text: (Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied, ante, p. 915.) The orders entered in this case on February 18, 1963, are amended to include the notation that Mr. Justice Brennan and Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of the motions or the petition.
